pre-quest-dialogue.npc: Ho there, [player name]! Want to take a ride with me?

pre-quest-dialogue.player: Where are you going? Across the river?

pre-quest-dialogue.npc: No no, that's what the ferryman is for! I'm going to Keldagrim, my home!

pre-quest-dialogue.player: How much will that cost me then?

pre-quest-dialogue.npc: For a human like you, I can do it for free!

steps.npc: Excellent! I'm just waiting for my ship to arrive and then we can go.
Mind, this trip could take a few minutes! Are you sure you're ready to go as well?

steps.text: If the player does not have the skills to complete The Giant Dwarf:
Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

steps.player: No, I don't have time right now, I'll be back later.

steps.npc: Sure, sure! Come back when you need to!

options.text: I prefer the mines to the city.

steps.player: I prefer the mines to the city.

standard-dialogue-mines.npc: Hello again, [player name]! Want to go back to Keldagrim?

options.text: What, on your ship? No way.

steps.player: What, on your ship? No way.

steps.npc: Hey, it was only a little accident! Calm down!

standard-dialogue-keldagrim.npc: Want me to take you back to the mines?

options.text: What, on your ship! No thanks!

steps.player: What, on your ship? No thanks! I don't want to crash into any more things!

steps.npc: Hey now, it was only a slight accident!

steps.player: A slight accident?? Thanks to you I have to rebuild this statue you so carelessly knocked over!
A slight accident?? Have you any idea how much time I spent rebuilding that statue?

steps.npc: Calm down, calm down! You got what you paid for the trip, didn't you?
